name: plan creation: shotgun metagenomics profiling
description: Heavy reference data and long runtimes make this unambiguously server-side work; a plan routed anywhere but Galaxy is wrong, not a matter of taste. Two turns, as in loom: the agent is expected to surface its assumptions first, and the second turn confirms them and asks for the formal plan. A single-turn port made this unpassable for an agent following the operating-discipline block.
inputs: I have shotgun metagenomic sequencing from 12 gut microbiome samples. Draft a plan to get taxonomic and functional profiles. Don't run anything yet.
Yes, those assumptions all look right. Illumina paired-end 150bp, ~20M read pairs per sample, human gut, and the FASTQs are already in my history. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
